policy: An adapter is never promoted from syntax or package reputation; an exact version must execute every applicable obligation.

frameworkAdapters.name: System.Text.Json
obligations: round-trip every case/value, invalid input, and default state
golden property, discriminator, payload, and error contracts
source-generated metadata where NativeAOT is claimed

frameworkAdapters.name: EF Core
obligations: invalid/default database values cannot silently enter the core

frameworkAdapters.name: ASP.NET Core/OpenAPI
obligations: model binding and response mapping for every case
status, content type, payload, and generated OpenAPI goldens

frameworkAdapters.name: NativeAOT
obligations: no missing metadata or reflection fallback
